post.description:
Run the batch update now, then dispatch new advisories, and return the batch summary.

Runs synchronously (FastAPI executes plain ``def`` routes in a worker thread). A
run with failed users still returns 200; check ``status`` and ``failed_user_ids``.
The dispatch outcome is logged (``POST /admin/dispatch-run`` returns it).

Returns:
    Counts and status of the run.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if a batch update is already in progress.

Deliver queued advisories now (R3) and return what happened.

Returns:
    Counts of sent, failed, expired, suppressed and blocked advisories.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 503 if Web Push is not configured, 409 if a dispatch is
        already running in this process.

Run the knowledge-base upgrade job now (R5) and return what it proposed.

It only inserts empty DRAFT entries for practitioners to write and approve; it
never publishes anything. A run that failed still returns 200 with ``status``
``failed`` (the error is in ``batch_runs`` and the log).

Returns:
    Counts, status and the ids of the new drafts.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if a KB upgrade run is already in progress.

Retrain the risk model now (R5) and return the promote/keep decision.

Runs synchronously: a full training takes a few minutes (``sample`` makes it
quicker). The candidate replaces the live model only if its test recall and
precision hold up; thresholds are never touched. A run whose training failed
still returns 200 with ``status`` ``failed`` and decision ``kept``.

Args:
    dry_run: Train and report, never promote.
    sample: Share of rows to train on, e.g. ``0.2``.

Returns:
    Status, decision, old and new metrics.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 503 if the BRFSS CSVs are missing, 409 if a retrain is
        already in progress.

get.description:
Return the signed-in patient's advisory and record that they opened it.

Args:
    advisory_id: Advisory to show.
    auth_user: Verified Supabase user.
    session_factory: Database sessions.
    audio_store: Signs the voice recording URL.
    settings: Supplies the signed-URL lifetime.

Returns:
    The advisory with a short-lived audio URL (``None`` if there is no recording
    or signing failed; the page then uses the browser's speech synthesis).

Raises:
    HTTPException: 401 without a session, 403 if the login is not linked or the
        advisory belongs to another patient, 404 if it does not exist.

Return the public configuration for the patient web app.

It is the first call both pages make, so it also checks (cached, bounded by the
connect timeout) that the database is reachable: the page then shows the reason
instead of every later call hanging.

Args:
    settings: Application settings.
    db_health: Cached database reachability check.

Returns:
    Supabase URL, publishable key and VAPID public key.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 503 if ``SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`` is not set, or if the database is
        unreachable (detail "database unreachable (port 5432 blocked?)").

post.description:
Handle one patient message (typed or spoken) and audit the turn.

Args:
    background: Post-commit tasks (notifications, advisory dispatch).
    auth_user: Verified login.
    session_factory: Database sessions.
    settings: Settings.
    kb_cache: TF-IDF index cache.
    rephraser: Optional LLM rephraser.
    transcriber: Speech-to-text.
    synthesizer: Text-to-speech for spoken replies.
    audio_store: Private audio storage.
    notifier: Push + Realtime.
    text: Typed message.
    audio: Recorded voice message.
    message_id: Client-generated id (retries return the stored reply).
    request_practitioner: The "Talk to a doctor" button was used.
    advisory_id: Advisory the button was on.

    The saved draft.

        is not a draft or its superseded entry changed, 422 without a body or a
        source citation.

    session_factory: Database sessions.

    HTTPException: 401/403 as above, 404 for an unknown id, 409 when the entry
